slides.title: A report, not a certificate
slides.body: A licensed CPA firm tests your controls against AICPA criteria and writes up what it found. Security is in every report.

slides.title: Type 1 is a snapshot
slides.body: It checks that your controls are designed properly at one point in time. Quicker to get, and a useful first step.

slides.title: Type 2 covers a period
slides.body: It checks that controls worked throughout a window of months. Most enterprise buyers ask for this one.

slides.title: You need it when buyers ask
slides.body: Deals stall in security review, or questionnaires pile up. If nobody has asked, the report can usually wait.

slides.title: Start before the deal depends on it
slides.body: A Type 2 window can't be rushed. Controls have to be running before it opens, and then it has to run its course.
